# Leaflet 1.9.4

Local distribution from the official npm `leaflet` package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/leaflet/-/leaflet-1.9.4.tgz

Upstream documentation: https://leafletjs.com/reference.html
License: BSD-2-Clause, see LICENSE. Source package URL and archive SHA-256 are recorded in SOURCE.json.

These files are served locally; no Node build or runtime CDN is required. Online map imagery is requested separately from OpenStreetMap when a map is opened. No tiles are included or downloaded for offline use.
